name: Auth Mock
description: UserContext value object, MOCK_USER for development, generic session-cookie helpers, and a dev-only root middleware that injects MOCK_USER when AUTH_MODE=mock. Real auth providers (google-oauth, supabase, etc.) overwrite the middleware with their own.

questions.prompt: Session cookie name? (used by the session-manager cookie helpers)

checklist: Set AUTH_MODE=mock for local development — the dev middleware will inject MOCK_USER as x-user-context on every request
Override MOCK_USER fields at runtime via MOCK_USER_NAME / MOCK_USER_EMAIL / MOCK_USER_ROLES / MOCK_USER_AVATAR_URL
Domain code depends on UserContext (src/domain/value-objects/user-context.ts) — not on a vendor user shape

Add a real auth provider template (google-oauth, github-oauth, microsoft-entra, magic-link, adobe-ims-spa, supabase) — its middleware will overwrite the dev middleware and handle real-mode auth end-to-end, while still honouring AUTH_MODE=mock as a dev short-circuit
Group B frameworks (nextauth, clerk, better-auth) own their own auth model and don't use this template's middleware
